title: Single-source parent-sign reproduction and full off-shell eligibility repair after invalid Phase 15A
registration_scope: This is a transparent reproduction and source-repair cycle, not a blind discovery cycle. Every source formula and candidate outcome already inspected during the invalid Phase 15A implementation review is declared below as a known prior. The cycle may ratify reproducibility and select only within the frozen two-source census. It cannot evaluate FLRW supersymmetry tangency, a spin-3/2 projection, a compensator quotient, canonical closure, a physical supercharge, or temporal branch exchange.

items: Under the literal Phase 15A Hohl map, the bosonic flat-FLRW reduction was manually found to give R_H=+6 Q and an all-positive (X,T,Y) kinetic inertia after the temporal endpoint term.

The Kallosh-Kofman-Linde-Van Proeyen source was manually inspected before this contract and found to use R_K=-6 Q on flat FLRW, giving the ADM-compatible (-,+,+) kinetic inertia with its own action and matter conventions.
The standard ADM Einstein-plus-canonical-complex-scalar reference was manually checked to give the same (-,+,+) kinetic inertia as the Kallosh bosonic parent.
The Kallosh source's printed dt=deta/a near its first FRW discussion conflicts with its own later dt=a deta equations; only the latter same-source relation is an anticipated emendation candidate.

The Kallosh source's printed G^0_0=+rho/M_P^2 near its first FRW discussion conflicts with its own Friedmann equation and appendix value G^0_0=-rho/M_P^2; only the latter same-source sign is an anticipated emendation candidate.

Hohl supplies the old-minimal auxiliary fields and the off-shell chiral-matter transformation family needed by the abandoned Phase 15A tangency design, while the audited Kallosh phenomenological action has eliminated auxiliaries and is only a bosonic-normalization candidate for this census.

The anticipated scoped aggregate is BOSONIC_PARENT_ONLY / NO_VALID_SINGLE_PARENT_IN_FROZEN_CENSUS. This must not be reported as a new result, a universal supergravity no-go, or evidence about temporal-folded SUSY.
known_priors_firewall.ratification_rule: A committed exact executable plus an independent replay may classify the two active reproduction targets, but may not convert any listed item into DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE evidence.

scope_lock.geometry: Compact flat T^3 fiducial cell of positive coordinate volume V_0 with ds^2=-N(t)^2 dt^2+a(t)^2 delta_ij dx^i dx^j, N>0 and a>0.
scope_lock.matter: One neutral canonical complex scalar Z=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), with W identically zero and no vectors or gauging. Fermions and auxiliaries enter only the source-coverage ledger, not the bosonic sign executable.

frozen_candidate_census.eligibility_claim_before_run: Provides the required old-minimal and chiral off-shell component coverage, but the known literal-map bosonic inertia mismatch must be reproduced rather than repaired by hand.
Provides an independently coherent Einstein-plus-chiral bosonic normalization control but not the auxiliary-retaining full off-shell transformation parent required by a future tangency cycle.

reference_only.role: A contract-defined exact internal geometric regression derived from +M_P^2 R_std/2-partial Z partial Zbar in the frozen mostly-plus convention. It is not an independent primary-literature control, is not a supergravity parent candidate, contributes no off-shell coverage, and cannot by itself support either active target. The evidential comparison in this cycle is explicitly limited to the two primary sources Hohl and Kallosh.

allowed_equivalences: source-internal notation changes frozen before the executable

derivative-free regular real point transformations q'=f(q) with det(partial f/partial q) nonzero and no lapse, velocity, or derivative dependence, checked by congruence of the first-order velocity Hessian

the single preregistered velocity-dependent endpoint B used in R1 to remove the raw curvature second derivative, followed only by regular endpoints dF(q,t)/dt with F independent of lapse and velocities
strictly positive lapse, strictly positive densitization, and strictly positive field-independent unit normalization
same-source typo emendations only when the frozen packet gives two independent internal anchors and a literal-mutant rejection
forbidden_repairs: combine a Hohl transformation with a Kallosh action or curvature convention
flip only the Einstein term or only a selected matter sector
use an unsupported editorial sign change in Hohl
multiply a selected sector by a negative factor
use X->i X, a Wick rotation, a complex field redefinition, negative lapse, or negative densitization
eliminate auxiliaries to manufacture full off-shell source coverage
delete a k=1 curvature term to claim k=0
evaluate P_3/2, rho_i, a tangency residual, a compensator, or any Phase 15A K2 expression
scope_lock.claim_ceiling: The strongest possible result is a source-scoped reproduction statement: at least one frozen source is an eligible bosonic normalization parent, and/or at least one frozen source independently supplies both that normalization and the full off-shell content required for a later separately preregistered tangency attempt. No universal existence or no-go statement is allowed.

source_lock.role: Immutable provenance disclosure and Hohl known-prior record only. It is not a valid Phase 15A result.
Single-source Hohl candidate: Kähler-superspace component action, curvature conventions, old-minimal auxiliary fields, and chiral-matter transformations.
Single-source Kallosh candidate: phenomenological N=1 matter-supergravity action and explicit flat-FRW curvature/energy conventions. It is not treated as an auxiliary-retaining off-shell parent.

target_claims.hypothesis: At least one source in the frozen Hohl/Kallosh census independently reproduces the ADM-compatible Lorentzian (-,+,+) Einstein-plus-canonical-chiral kinetic inertia under only the frozen allowed equivalences.

At least one same source in the frozen Hohl/Kallosh census independently supplies both the accepted bosonic parent normalization and the auxiliary-retaining old-minimal plus one-chiral off-shell action/transformation coverage required before any later tangency calculation.

record every design-stage formula and anticipated candidate classification above as a known prior with zero novelty weight
use a separate source-tagged derivation graph for Hohl, Kallosh, and the internal ADM reference; no symbolic node may have parents from two tags

reproduce or refute the known-prior Kallosh target R_K=-6 Q and L_K,raw=+dot(B)-3 M_P^2 V_0 a dot(a)^2/N

gates.candidate_pass_rule: A bosonic candidate passes only if its own source-tagged action yields the ADM-compatible one-negative/two-positive inertia under the frozen equivalences.
gates.candidate_reject_rule: An exact nondegenerate inertia mismatch rejects that candidate; it does not make the cycle invalid and is not a universal no-go.

acceptance: for each candidate independently inventory e_mu^a, psi_mu, M, Mbar, b_a, Z, Zbar, chi, chibar, F, Fbar and the action plus local-supersymmetry transformation families required by the abandoned Stage-A design
distinguish an auxiliary-retaining off-shell parent from an action in which auxiliaries have already been eliminated
require the same source candidate to pass R2 and the coverage matrix; a bosonic-only parent cannot pass the full target
reject Hohl-action plus Kallosh-curvature or Kallosh-action plus Hohl-transformations as invalid source stacking
gates.coverage_definition: For this repair cycle, full-off-shell coverage means source availability in one convention-complete primary source of the auxiliary-uneliminated component action and local-supersymmetry transformation formulas for every listed old-minimal and chiral field. It does not assert that this cycle proves off-shell invariance, algebraic closure, a canonical constraint algebra, or truncation tangency.
gates.scope: Coverage is evaluated only for the frozen two-source census and does not claim completeness of the literature.

acceptance: classify the bosonic-parent target and full-off-shell-parent target independently
persist every candidate's curvature, boundary, Hessian, inertia, coverage, and rejection reason in the run result
give no evidential inheritance to Phase 15A tangency or the temporal-superpartner thesis
contain no spin-3/2 projector, discarded-mode residual, compensator quotient, canonical constraint, quantum operator, Q_phys, or branch-exchange calculation
do not call a source typo repair a physical resolution and do not call a scoped frozen-census failure a universal no-go
do not open a tangency cycle unless the full-off-shell same-source target is SUPPORTS

invalid_if: the source/convention/coverage packet or executable is created, imported, or scientifically evaluated out of the frozen artifact order
one derivation graph combines source tags
an unsupported sign flip, analytic continuation, negative lapse, negative densitizer, or sector-specific multiplier is used
a K2 tangency or projection expression is evaluated
the same target is classified as both SUPPORTS and CONTRADICTS

bosonic_target.supports_if: R0-R2 and R5 pass and at least one frozen candidate independently passes the exact ADM-compatible inertia test; classify VALID/SUPPORTS/NONE.
bosonic_target.contradicts_if: R0-R2 and R5 are complete and no frozen candidate independently passes the exact ADM-compatible inertia test; classify VALID/CONTRADICTS/NO_VALID_BOSONIC_PARENT_IN_FROZEN_CENSUS.
bosonic_target.inconclusive_if: Any required source curvature, action, scalar normalization, boundary identity, or exact Legendre map is unresolved; classify VALID/INCONCLUSIVE/UNCONSTRUCTED.
bosonic_target.candidate_status_note: A passing candidate may separately be labeled BOSONIC_PARENT_ONLY in the candidate ledger when it lacks R3 coverage; that candidate label is not the active bosonic target's qualification.

full_offshell_target.supports_if: R0-R3 and R5 pass and at least one same frozen candidate passes both the bosonic inertia test and the frozen full-off-shell coverage matrix without source stacking; classify VALID/SUPPORTS/NONE. Candidate multiplicity is recorded separately and cannot change this existence inference.
full_offshell_target.contradicts_if: R0-R3 and R5 are complete and no same candidate in the frozen census passes both tests; classify VALID/CONTRADICTS/NO_VALID_SINGLE_PARENT_IN_FROZEN_CENSUS.
full_offshell_target.inconclusive_if: The frozen-census coverage matrix or source map is incomplete; classify VALID/INCONCLUSIVE/SOURCE_INCOMPLETE.

parent_selection_status.policy: This is an aggregate status, not an active-target inference or qualification. MULTIPLE_NON_EQUIVALENT_ELIGIBLE blocks automatic selection even though the existence target is SUPPORTS.

verdict_precedence: INVALID takes precedence for both targets
each active target is classified independently
complete exact target failure gives CONTRADICTS
complete exact target satisfaction gives SUPPORTS
simultaneous SUPPORTS and CONTRADICTS for one target gives INVALID with INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY
artifact_order: In a second pre-result commit freeze PHASE15R_SOURCE_CONVENTION_PACKET.json, including hashes, source scopes, typo packets, source-tag graph rules, and the full-off-shell coverage matrix.
In a third commit add the complete phase15r_parent_sign_reproduction.py executable. It may be statically reviewed but must not be imported or run before that commit.
Run the committed executable for the first time and persist PHASE15R_RUN_RESULT.json in a post-run commit.
Perform an independent read-only replay of the committed executable and persist PHASE15R_REPLAY_RECEIPT.json in a later commit.
Only after replay update PHASE15R_PARENT_SIGN_REPAIR.md, README, and STATUS.
frozen_decision.sequencing_rule: Phase 15R ends after source-scoped reproduction. A bosonic-parent SUPPORTS result alone does not reopen tangency. Only full-offshell-target SUPPORTS may motivate a new, separately preregistered tangency cycle.

semantic_mutants: use Hohl's action with Kallosh's Riemann convention
use Kallosh's bosonic action with Hohl's auxiliary transformations
flip only the Hohl Einstein sign
use a negative lapse or negative densitizer
drop the temporal endpoint term without displaying it
silently accept either Kallosh typo without the frozen same-source anchors
treat auxiliary elimination as full off-shell coverage
claim that the two-source census exhausts 4D N=1 supergravity
evaluate the clean cubic P_3/2 probe from the invalid Phase 15A draft

comparison_policy.symbolic: Exact rational/algebraic equality after each separately tagged source map; floating-point comparison is forbidden.
comparison_policy.matrix: Exact Hessian equality, determinant/nondegeneracy, and inertia by exact congruence or exact principal/eigenvalue sign analysis on the positive parameter patch.
comparison_policy.boundary: Exact total-derivative identity before any Legendre transform.

non_goals: spin-3/2 projection or a discarded-mode census
Dirac-Bergmann stabilization or graded canonical closure
quantization, a physical inner product, or a physical supercharge

a literature-exhaustive or universal supergravity no-go
